info.title: cloudmail API
info.description: HTTP API for mailboxes, messages and instance administration. Authenticate with an API token (`Authorization: Bearer ttk_<id>_<secret>`) or a browser session cookie. Each operation's `x-token-scope` names the token scope it needs; `any` means every authenticated caller. Mailbox routes additionally require a grant on that mailbox, and `x-mailbox-capability` names the capability the grant must include.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes a retry safe. The first request with a key runs and its response is kept for 24 hours, per caller (user and API token) and route. A repeat with the same body returns that response with `Idempotent-Replayed: true` and does nothing; the same key with a different body is 409 `idempotency_key_reused`; a repeat while the first is still running is 409 `idempotency_request_in_progress` with `Retry-After: 1`. 5xx responses are not kept, so a retry can succeed. 1-256 printable ASCII characters; a UUID per logical operation works well.

patch.summary: Pick the Workers AI model per role (admin, signed-in person)
patch.description: `models` maps a role to a `@cf/…` or `@hf/…` id, or null for the default. Used whenever a role runs on Workers AI: no active gateway, an exception, or fallback. Checked like gateway picks: agent chat and auto-draft need verified function calling, triage verified JSON mode (run Test first when the catalogue doesn't say), embeddings a 1024-dimension embedding model. The prompt-injection scanner can't be changed. Changing the embeddings model re-indexes every mailbox, so it needs `confirmReindex: true` (else 422 `reindex_confirm_required`). `SUMMARY_MODEL` applies only while summaries have no pick here. Changes need a signed-in person: an API token or connected app gets 403 `person_required`.

post.summary: Apply chosen plan items: auto items, and confirm items sent with confirm: true (admin)
post.description: Recomputes the plan from fresh discovery. 409 `plan_stale` (with the new `items` and `planHash`) when the hash differs. 400 `zone_not_selected`, `zone_not_visible`, `unknown_item`, `not_applicable` (manual/done) or `confirm_required`. Items run in dependency order; failures are per-item results, and dependents are skipped. Every DNS write and catch-all overwrite is logged for revert. 412 `not_connected` / `reconnect_required` without a usable token. Needs a browser session that re-confirmed its password or passkey in the last 15 minutes (POST /api/auth/passkeys/reauth): 403 `session_required` or `reauth_required` otherwise.

post.summary: Send a message now
post.description: Every send passes the pre-send gate: Cloudflare's per-message limits, the mailbox's send caps (429), and suppressions. Transactional (the default): recipients that hard-bounced or complained are dropped and listed in `suppressed`; unsubscribed ones are sent to and listed in `suppression_warnings`. `transactional:false`/`list:true`: every suppressed recipient is dropped, the message gets List-Unsubscribe (one-click) and List-Id, and the send is refused with 423 `bulk_paused` while the domain's spam-rate breaker is tripped. No deliverable To recipient left: 422 `all_suppressed`. Held for approval: an API token or OAuth app without `mail:send:auto`, on a mailbox whose `agentSend.mode` is `approve` (the default), gets 202 `{status:"pending_approval", approval_id, approval_url}` and nothing is sent until a person approves it. `draft_only` refuses with 403. Browser sessions are never held.

post.summary: Start a mail import (file upload or IMAP)
post.description: File sources (`mbox`, `zip` of .eml, single `eml`) create an upload: PUT each part to `/imports/{id}/parts/{n}` (`upload.part_size` bytes each, the last part the remainder), then POST `/complete`. `imap` starts at once: the app password is encrypted at rest with AUTH_SECRET-derived keys and deleted when the job ends; the host must be public, and the connection is TLS on port 993. Imported mail keeps its Date and Message-ID, threads by Message-ID, maps Gmail labels (X-Gmail-Labels) and IMAP folders onto folders and labels, and is deduplicated. It never triggers forwarding, auto-replies, webhooks, notifications, triage or follow-ups. At most three unfinished imports per mailbox.

SendApproval.description: An agent or MCP send waiting for a person.

status.description: sent_unconfirmed: the provider may have accepted it (a timeout or ambiguous error, or a send interrupted mid-flight). Final; never retried.

messages.description: Exactly what approve sends, as stored at hold time (templates rendered, the draft verified).

tracking_added_at_send.description: Open and click tracking is added when it is sent, per the mailbox settings.

editable.description: A pending single message can be edited with PATCH, or revised by its requester with POST …/revise.

revision.description: 1 when stored, +1 per edit or revision. Pass it to approve so a newer version is never sent unseen.

revised_by.description: requester: the agent revised its own send; reviewer: a person edited it.

bullets.description: Up to 3 bullets covering the conversation so far; fewer when there is less to say.

message_count.description: Messages the summary was generated from.

stale.description: The conversation changed since; a regeneration is queued or can be requested.

bulkSummaries.description: Summarise newsletters and notifications too (one-liner and bullets).

semantic.description: Semantic search and Ask: embed new mail. Off falls back to full-text.

embedDailyCapPerMailbox.description: Embedding calls per mailbox per UTC day.

source.description: provider: the gateway said so; hint: inferred from the model family; probe: passed or failed Test; admin: set by an administrator.

apiBase.description: Where API paths go: the base URL with `/v1` (or the gateway's own prefix).

needsCustomIds.description: Azure and Cloudflare AI Gateway: enter model or deployment ids yourself.

gatewayProviderId.description: The active gateway; null means Workers AI for everything.

source.description: admin: picked in settings; env: SUMMARY_MODEL; default: built in.

line.description: e.g. All AI runs on Cloudflare Workers AI.

approvals.description: Notify when a send waits in Pending approval.

followups.description: Notify when a follow-up reminder comes due.

mode.description: all: every Inbox message. important: needs-reply (you are in the thread), high priority or a VIP sender. products: only mail to the listed products.

mailboxes.description: Per-mailbox override, keyed by address: all, important or off. PUT `inherit` to remove one.

vipSenders.description: Addresses or @domains that always count as important.

hideContent.description: Show only "New mail in <mailbox>": no sender or subject.

timeZone.description: IANA zone; null uses the zone from AI assistant settings.

push_service.description: Host of the push service endpoint

sampled.description: Some Cloudflare rows were sampled; counts are estimates.

AnalyticsOverview.description: See shared/analytics-types.ts (Overview). Rates are fractions 0..1, or null when the denominator is 0.

Unauthorized.description: Not signed in, or the token is invalid

Forbidden.description: Authenticated, but the grant or token scope does not allow this

PreconditionFailed.description: A required configuration (such as a Cloudflare connection) is missing

PreconditionRequired.description: Explicit confirmation required; resend with the named flag

Locked.description: `code: bulk_paused`: bulk sending from this domain is paused by the spam-rate circuit breaker until an administrator resumes it.

BadGateway.description: An upstream service answered with an error

IdempotencyConflict.description: `code: idempotency_key_reused`: the Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request. `code: idempotency_request_in_progress`: a request with this key is still running; retry after `Retry-After` seconds. On routes that create something, a plain conflict with existing state also answers 409.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait; sent with idempotency_request_in_progress.

bearerAuth.description: API token. A token may carry scopes: mail:read, mail:send, mail:draft, mail:organize, mailboxes:manage, domains:manage, webhooks:manage, admin. Scopes only narrow; the effective permission is the intersection of the user's grant and the token's scopes. A token without scopes acts with the user's full access.

sessionCookie.name: __Host-tt_session
sessionCookie.description: Browser session cookie set at sign-in. Named `tt_session` on plain-http development servers. Cross-site writes are refused by CSRF protection.
